threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still say 'the Tube' instead of just 'the Overground' when talking about getting around. We all know the real underground is the coffee culture.
Last night on the 59, a group of teens ordered takeaway mid-route. The driver just grinned and let them eat in peace. Brixton nights are always livelier.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a pigeon stealing a slice of döner from a tourist's plate outside Doldy. Classic Neukölln moment – the locals just laughed.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice how the Trams here have no announcements for stops? You just hop off when you feel it's right. It's like a secret Berlin art form.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here if they can name at least three taquerias and have a strong opinion on which salsa is the best.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 5-Fulton at Civic Center and a guy in a full tuxedo got on with a karaoke machine. Only in SF, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is just about Gaudí, but it’s the corner bakeries and local markets that have the real soul. They miss the everyday magic.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they're new when they still stroll through the Parc Güell without realizing the locals avoid it like the plague.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think it's acceptable to call it 'the tube' instead of just 'overground' when you're in Dalston.
Last night on the 196, some bloke serenaded us with a guitar. Half the bus joined in, the other half rolled their eyes. Classic Brixton vibes.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a street musician in front of the old bakery, playing medieval tunes while kids danced around. Classic Neukölln chaos, love it!

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find a club in an old cookie factory, where the scent of chocolate mingles with techno beats at 3 AM.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they're local if they can name all the taquerias on that one block, but the newcomers just think ‘taco’ means the chain on the corner.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 21 bus while the driver stopped to give a homeless guy a granola bar. Real moments like that you won't find on any brochure.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think we all drink vermut in fancy bars but locals prefer a good canya at the dive bars—way better atmosphere and authentic vibes.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You’ll see them clutching a printed map, no idea that Google Maps works just as well. Always stop to take photos of the same Gaudí buildings, too.
